subject: ▶️ Recording Ready — $session_title ($session_date)
body:
Dear $participant_name,

The recording for the session below is now processed and available to view.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
RECORDING DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Session ID:        $session_id
Classroom:         $classroom_name
Session Type:      $session_type
Date:              $session_date
Host:              $host_name
Recording Length:  $recording_duration
File Size:         $recording_size
Recording Link:    $recording_url
Transcript:        $transcript_url
Captions:          $captions_url
Available Until:   $expires_on

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

NOTES

  • The link requires you to be signed into your university account.
  • Sharing the recording outside the University is not permitted under the AUP.
  • If you spot a captioning error, please report it via the Accessibility portal — your fix is published the same day.

If you missed the session, the recording is the official catch-up resource; you do not need to email the host for slides separately.

Kind regards,
Virtual Classroom Team
